mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) at its current level of 0.12% is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 8.0%, it predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE > 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are below 550 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 8.0%, the S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days are negative.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where HOUST < 550 AND UNRATE > 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) being above 2.0% predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When employment (PAYEMS) exceeds 130000, it predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS > 130000.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95, it predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO < 95.

mechanism_narrative: The housing starts (HOUST) at its current level of 574.0 is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances where HOUST is at 574.0.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are below 550 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 0.5%, the S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days are positive.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances where HOUST < 550 AND FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.
